//: Playwright config and e2e specs run under Node, not the browser -- unlike the rest of this package, they need process.env and Node module resolution, not DOM types or bundler resolution. Kept as a separate tooling project (not folded into tsconfig.json) rather than widening that project's types to include "node" alongside "vite/client", which would let a stray `process.env` reference type-check inside browser src/ code that can never actually see it at runtime.
